name: Witch Hunter: Auto Shot's +15% ranged attack speed survives relogs, login hooks and reconnects (O-21)
contract: Auto Shot 75 reads 'Increases your ranged Attack Speed by 15%.' for a holder of 552011, which the live baseline grants to the Witch Hunter (owner ruling O-21, mentor D-127). Witch Hunter code applies it through Unit::ApplyAttackTimePercentMod(RANGED_ATTACK, 15, apply), the call an aura 140 of amount 15 makes, so the ranged base attack time (UNIT_FIELD_BASEATTACKTIME + 2) is the weapon delay x 100 / 115. A CustomData flag makes the sync idempotent on login, learn and forget. Every assert window is the expected value +-1 ms; it excludes the lost bonus (the weapon delay) and a doubled bonus (delay x (100 / 115)^2 = delay / 1.3225). Weapon delays: Old Blunderbuss 2508 2300 ms, Light Crossbow 15807 2500 ms, Heavy Crossbow 15809 2800 ms (item_template delay). The bonus must hold once after two relogs (native save and login), a replayed login hook on the same Player and a reconnect to the character in the world (no hook); forgetting Auto Shot removes it and learning it again restores it.
